rationale: Builds on the best recurrent-tail family with a compact structural edit instead of another scalar sweep. The new per-tail-block anchor refresh gate lets reverse recurrence partially refresh the decoder-output anchor toward the current tail state before carry/replay, targeting the locally promising reverse-tail anchor variants while staying compile-stable, size-light, and quantization-aware. Control-pattern inclusion keeps the new gates in the float-preserved path so the final int8 roundtrip can benefit rather than immediately crushing the added degrees of freedom.
title: Reverse-Tail Anchor Gate Refresh
